items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So Pee Wee ended up moving there when he was his musical director

ctx.x: . . . in Frome, and he has a studio there. So Pee Wee ended up moving there when he was his musical director, and he stayed, got married. That was that. So, when Javon couldn’t make the gig – and it was a fabulous festival, a literary festival.
We got a tape of that somewhere too.
